annotations.title: No Surprises Act IDR: the cell that decides the dispute and the offer band

description: Federal No Surprises Act independent dispute resolution (45 CFR 149.510), computed from the CMS Federal IDR public use file (2025 Q4, 532,542 disputes, 1.41M line items). For a CPT/HCPCS code, payer (email domain or common name) and state, with an optional certified IDR entity and QPA in dollars: determinations in the cell, provider win rate, the quartiles of winning provider offers as multiples of QPA, the plan's usual offer, the losing providers' median ask, default-decision share, median days, every arbitrator's provider loss rate in the cell with its 2026 fee and certification status (IPRO and Network Medical Review decertified Nov 4 2026), the top three entities to propose, the recommended offer band (cell median to 75th percentile of winning multiples) and, with a QPA, the band and expected value in dollars. Vintage and flags on every answer. Free when the cell has under 50 determinations or with preview=true (cell size and win rate only); otherwise with a Tensorust enterprise key. Data only: Tensorust does not file or represent.

entity.description: Optional arbitrator to evaluate: FHAS, PRI, MCMC, MAXIMUS, C2C, IMPROVE, EDIPHY, NMR, ACENTRA, MET, PROPEER, CAPBRIDGE, LIVANTA, IPRO, NMRC

payer.description: Payer email domain as the file records it (uhc.com, bcbstx.com, aetna.com, cigna.com, multiplan.com, anthem.com, clearhs.com, centene.com) or a common name (UnitedHealthcare, BCBS Texas, Aetna)

preview.description: true: free answer with the cell size and win rate only

qpa.description: Optional qualifying payment amount in dollars

state.description: Two-letter state of service, e.g. TX
